name.description: The test's fully qualified name, as listed

verdict.description: relevant = a realistic mistake in a line this diff adds or removes would make the test fail; irrelevant = the test would pass whatever those lines said, so it guards code the change did not touch

changed_line.description: Required when relevant: one line the diff adds or removes, copied exactly, that the test guards

mistake.description: Required when relevant: a realistic way that line could have been written wrong, and why the test would then fail

reason.description: One sentence for the pull request: what the test guards, and why that is or is not something this change could have broken
